component.name: Scum With Cats
component.summary: Play Scum against three AI cats

description.p: Four-player Scum (President, Vice President, Vice Scum, Scum) against three computer-controlled cats. Aces high, deuces low, suits irrelevant. Lead singles, pairs, triples, or quads and beat your rivals to shed every card. The losers trade their best cards to the winners before each round. Also includes the original Hearts, Spades, and Oh Hell modes from Cards With Cats.
Fixed rounds freezing when a match was started with the menu still open; added watchdog recovery.
Added a Scum rules summary to the About dialog.
Play button moved to the right-hand side, Pass to the left, both inset toward the middle.
Initial release of the Scum game mode.
